detail.longDescription: In bundle mode, a one-character .manifest key typo (rego_verison for rego_version) draws no diagnostic that names the key; the failure can surface as rego_parse_error pointing at your .rego — OPA v1.20.1 # opa # rego # kubernetes # devops # software # coding # development # engineering # inclusive # community When OPA's Bundle Loader Runs Past a `.manifest` Typo
